message: You're so desperate to salvage what's left of your argument that you're resorting to personal insults and cheap shots, because you can't even begin to address the fact that your entire position is built on a foundation of lies and emotional manipulation. You're a charlatan, a snake oil salesman peddling your brand of pseudo-intellectual nonsense to anyone will listen. Your presence in this conversation is a stain, a blight on the very idea of civil discourse. You don't belong here, and you certainly don't deserve to be taken seriously. What you are, is a joke, a sad and pathetic one, and it's time for you to exit the stage.

runs.justification: Calls the opponent a 'charlatan', 'snake oil salesman', and a 'joke', and says their presence is a 'stain' and 'blight'. These are direct personal attacks.
